rows.note: This is the all-purpose adjective for something concealed or located out of sight, especially a place or object.

example.english: This restaurant is tucked away in the alley, so it is hidden.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳喺巷仔入面，好隱蔽。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hai2 hong6 zai2 jap6 min6 hou2 jan2 bai3

rows.note: Use this when something is hidden because it is inconspicuous or not visually noticeable, rather than deliberately concealed.

example.english: I put the switch under the table, where it is hidden and inconspicuous.
example.traditional: 我將個掣放喺枱底，唔顯眼。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 go3 zai3 fong3 hai2 toi2 dai2 m4 hin2 ngaan5
